verdict.rationale: Square's docs list a first-party Subscriptions API, so recurring billing appears to be a product capability. The pack holds only the page title, with no detail on how it works. The community item is an old question about whether subscriptions exist, not a counter-example, so it does not create a dispute. missing for 10: documented subscription plans/plan variations, free trials, upgrade/downgrade flows, proration behavior, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set up recurring subscription billing with plans, trials, upgrades, and proration
